identificationModule.briefTitle: Intensity-modulated Radiation Therapy Combined With Cisplatin or Nedaplatin Chemotherapy in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase II Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of Intensity-modulated Radiation Therapy Combined With Cisplatin or Nedaplatin Chemotherapy in Patients With Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma

leadSponsor.name: Daping Hospital and the Research Institute of Surgery of the Third Military Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This phase II trial is studying cisplatin or nedaplatin combine with IMRT to evaluate which one is better efficacy and security in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

secondaryOutcomes.description: 1 year Progress Free Survival,Disease Free Survival,3 years and 5 years Over All Survival,Safety

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age≥18,T1-2aN1-3;T2-4NxNPC,VEGFR+,++,KPS\>70,Life expectancy≥6 months, No uncontrolled hypertension,cardiac failure,diabetes,lunacy

Exclusion Criteria:

Distant metastasis, recurrent disease
